LINEBMLD.description: Line Beam Load (LINEBMLD). Adds a line/beam load to elements or along a loading line; the load geometry, direction, eccentricity, additional-H and copy options are driven by TYPE (load kind) and TARGET.METHOD (element selection vs loading line).

LCNAME.description: Load Case Name. Must reference an existing static load case.

TYPE.description: Load Type (case-insensitive). Drives load geometry and which sub-fields apply: CONLOAD/CONMOMENT concentrated force/moment, UNILOAD/UNIMOMENT uniform force/moment, TRALOAD/TRAMOMENT trapezoidal force/moment, CURVED curved line load (uses LOAD.A/B/C instead of D/P), UNIPRESSURE/TRAPRESSURE pressure (enables ADD_H, disables eccentricity).

METHOD.description: Element Selection method: 0 = loading line (defined by NODE pair), 1 = select element (ELEM required and non-empty).

NODE.description: Nodes for Loading Line: [I-node, J-node]. Both must be existing node numbers.

ELEM.description: [METHOD=1] Element numbers the load is applied to; required and non-empty when METHOD == 1.

ECCEN.description: Eccentricity settings. Only applied for non-pressure TYPEs; ignored for UNIPRESSURE/TRAPRESSURE.

TYPE.description: Eccentricity Type; must be 0 or 1 when USE is true.

DIR.description: Eccentricity Direction (case-insensitive): LX/LY/LZ local, GX/GY/GZ global.

J_END.description: Eccentricity distance at J-end; used only when USE_J_END is true.

ADD_H.description: Additional H from Top. Only applied for pressure TYPEs (UNIPRESSURE/TRAPRESSURE).

I_END.description: Additional distance at I-end; required when USE is true.

J_END.description: Additional distance at J-end; used only when USE_J_END is true.

DIR.description: Load Direction (case-insensitive): LX/LY/LZ local, GX/GY/GZ global. For METHOD=1 (select element) only GX/GY/GZ are valid; for pressure TYPEs only LY/LZ are valid.

USE_PROJECTION.description: Use Projection. Defaults to false for METHOD=0 (loading line) and true for METHOD=1 (select element); projection must be enabled when METHOD == 1.

TYPE.description: Value type: 0 = relative (distance ratios), non-zero = absolute distances. For CURVED this is the curve method (0 or 1); C is required when it equals 1.

D.description: [TYPE!=CURVED] Distance positions/ratios (up to 4 used). Required when TYPE is not CURVED.

P.description: [TYPE!=CURVED] Load values at the corresponding distances (up to 4 used). Required when TYPE is not CURVED.

A.description: [TYPE=CURVED] Curved load parameter A. Required when TYPE is CURVED.

B.description: [TYPE=CURVED] Curved load parameter B. Required when TYPE is CURVED.

C.description: [TYPE=CURVED] Curved load parameter C. Required when TYPE is CURVED and LOAD.TYPE == 1.

COPY.description: Copy Load settings. Only applied when METHOD=0 (loading line) and USE is true.

AXIS.description: Copy Axis (case-insensitive): X, Y or Z. Required when USE is true.

DIST.description: Copy Distances expression. Required when USE is true.
